name: Og
overview: Og was a formidable king of Bashan, known for his gigantic stature and leadership over his people, who confronted Israel at Edrei. God assured Moses not to fear Og, promising victory as had been granted over Sihon, and Moses ultimately defeated and killed Og along with his sons and people. The land formerly ruled by Og was then given to the tribes of Gad, Reuben, and half the tribe of Manasseh, fulfilling God's promise to Israel and expanding their inheritance.
